name: Hot or Iced
source:
Welcome to Aron Isles, your new home! 

Aside from the many popular tourist destinations scattered around town, there are a few hidden gems known only to the locals. One of those diamonds in the rough happens to be a hidden away coffee shop called 'Affogato Go'. Good, cheap coffee and very hot baristas.

The owner and staff make sure everyone feels welcome to enter and encouraged to return again. You visit often with your friend and know each barista's schedules by now. Frequent regulars are known by all and come to know the spot as a home away from home. 

However, things don't always go as planned. Aron Isles is no stranger to secrets and these baristas may have a few of their own, just like you...

[From [url=https://phonyroni.itch.io/hot-or-iced]itch.io[/url]]
